note: Hamilton County NY does not zone its unincorporated land; no county zoning layer found in ArcGIS search or web search. Towns with zoning (Inlet, Lake Pleasant, Indian Lake) publish zoning district maps only as PDF/images (InletZoning.pdf, Lake Pleasant Zoning-District-Map.pdf) and ordinance text; no queryable ArcGIS zoning service found. Adirondack Park Agency land use map is a state land use plan, not zoning districts.
